title: Build TopBar component with greeting and project context
description:
Create `dashboard/frontend/components/landing/TopBar.tsx`.

Props: `{ projectName: string, branch: string }`

Behavior:
- Compute greeting client-side from `new Date().getHours()`: 'Good morning' (5-11), 'Good afternoon' (12-17), 'Good evening' (18-4). User name hardcoded as 'Sanjay' for V1 (no auth system).
- Display: greeting text (left), project name + branch (right) with mono font for project/branch.
- Use `.type-section-label` for greeting, `.type-mono` for project/branch values.
- Use `--text` for greeting, `--text-secondary` for project/branch labels.
- Follow 4px spacing grid. Component height ~48px with 24px horizontal padding.
acceptance_criteria:
- Component renders greeting based on current hour
  verify_by: test
- Project name and branch displayed with mono font
  verify_by: manual
- No hardcoded colors outside design tokens from globals.css
  verify_by: lint
- Component accepts projectName and branch as props
  verify_by: lint

spec_references.requirement: S7: greeting with project name and branch
Greeting requires timezone — computed on the client

rationale: TopBar is a leaf component with no data dependencies beyond simple string props. Building it early allows parallel work on panel components. Depends on task 9 only because it lives in the landing component directory and the query types inform its prop types.
assumptions: User name hardcoded to 'Sanjay' since there's no auth system — Q3 from open questions resolved as yes for time-of-day awareness
decisions: Task spec referenced .type-section-label and .type-mono but neither exists in globals.css. Used .type-section-header (Inter 13px 600, --text) for the greeting and .type-mono-value (IBM Plex Mono 13px 500) for project/branch values — closest matches that satisfy the stated intent.

Project/branch labels ('project', 'branch') use .type-caption with color: var(--color-text-secondary) inline override since .type-caption defaults to tertiary; the task spec explicitly calls for secondary color on labels.
TopBar is a thin flex bar (height 48px, px-6) with no .surface wrapper — it's a bar element meant to sit above the grid, not an elevated card.
concerns: The test file was not declared in the task plan's files_touched, so the scope gate warns (non-blocking). The tests are written for vitest + @testing-library/react but neither is installed in package.json — they will not run until task 19 (or equivalent) wires up the test framework.
.type-section-label and .type-mono do not exist in globals.css. If these classes are added later (e.g. by task 20 or a design system update), the component should be updated to use them.
